content_sections.heading: NIT Delhi Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidates shall be responsible for conducting on-site inspections, material testing, and structural framework integrity evaluations for assigned third-party quality assurance projects or similar type consultancy project works. The duties shall include: Laboratory testing and analysis Preparation of technical reports Documentation of observations and findings Monitoring compliance with relevant standards and specifications Carrying out other project-related, testing, consultancy, and technical assignments as entrusted from time to time

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 2 Sr. Project Technical Assistant (Civil), 1 Sr. Project Technical Assistant (Electrical), 1 Junior Project Technical Assistant, 1 Junior Project Assistant, 3 Project Engineer (Civil), 1 Project Engineer (Electrical/Mechanical) and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 42,600 for Sr. Project Technical Assistant (Civil), Honorarium fee as per institute rule on Visit Basis for Sr. Project Technical Assistant (Electrical), Rs. 32,800 for Junior Project Technical Assistant, Rs. 32,800 for Junior Project Assistant, Rs. 55,000 for Project Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma / B.Tech / B.E / M.Tech in relevant engineering discipline with required experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The remuneration shall be fixed including TA and no additional emoluments shall be admissible for site visits, field duties, or attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview evaluated by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for a period of Twelve (12) months, extendable up to March 2028 based on project requirement, performance and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Delhi.
